title.narrative: Restoring Essential Health Services and WASH Facilities for Conflict Affected Communities in Alamata Woreda, Ethiopia

description.narrative: This project aims to restore critical health services and improve access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) for conflict-affected communities in Alamata Woreda, focusing on the rehabilitation of health centres and WASH facilities in Garjela and Tao Kebeles. The project will assess and renovate damaged health infrastructure, ensure the availability of clean water and functional sanitation systems, and provide essential medical equipment and supplies. Through these interventions, the project seeks to enhance the delivery of quality healthcare services, promote better hygiene practices, and support the recovery and resilience of vulnerable populations affected by the conflict.
